blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Image scanning microscopy (ISM) acquires one scanned image per detector element, which are then fused into a single image by multi-image deconvolution to obtain a super-resolved image. Its accuracy, however, depends on point spread function (PSF) models that sample- and system-induced aberrations often invalidate. Since differences between the scanned images encode aberration information, we propose a training-free blind Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework that jointly estimates the specimen and the detector-dependent PSFs. The PSFs are parametrised through the detector geometry and shared excitation and emission PSFs, reducing the unknowns while preserving the physical ISM model, and a Gaussian pre-initialisation stabilises the blind optimisation. On experimental tubulin data, blind DIP recovers finer filamentous structures than multi-image deconvolution and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, while adapting the PSFs to the measurements.
blocks.zh: 图像扫描显微镜(ISM)获得每个探测器元件一个被扫描的图像,然后由多图像分解而被熔化为单一的图像来得到超解的图像. 然而,它的准确性取决于点散函数(PSF)模型,而样本和系统引起的异常往往无效. 由于扫描图像编码异常信息之间的差异,我们建议建立一个无训练的盲深图像前导(DIP)框架,共同估计标本和检测器依赖的PSF. PSF通过探测器几何和共享的激出并释放出PSF来进行截取,在保留物理的ISM模型的同时减少未知数,并使用高斯语进行初始化前稳定盲优化. 在实验管子素数据上,盲DIP恢复了比多成像分解更细的丝状结构并带有固定理论PSF的DIP,同时使PSF适应测量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image scanning microscopy (ISM) replaces the single-element detector of confocal laser-scanning microscopy with a detector array to produce super-resolved images with a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) [ 10 ] .
The array elements simultaneously record scanned images, each containing complementary spatial information owing to the different positions of the elements in the detection plane. Each element acts as a small pinhole, providing the resolution benefits of narrow-pinhole confocal detection, while neighboring elements collect otherwise rejected photons, preserving a high photon budget. Multi-image deconvolution (MID) combines these images using their detector-dependent PSFs [ 13 ] ; extending its forward model to account for a three-dimensional specimen also enables optical sectioning [ 14 ] . These PSFs are often derived from theoretical models that may not capture experimental aberrations. Crucially, differences among the scanned images encode information about these aberrations [ 7 ] , providing additional constraints for PSF estimation and motivating blind deconvolution.

Its set of solutions can, however, be restricted by exploiting the (possibly estimated) detector geometry, which determines how the kernels are related to one another.

In the non-blind setting, DIP has proved flexible and effective in practice [ 1 , 6 ] , and in some regimes it comes with theoretical convergence and recovery guarantees [ 3 , 4 ] .

blocks.en: In this work, we develop a DIP-based approach for blind ISM reconstruction that jointly estimates the underlying image and the set of convolution kernels. The optical ISM model expresses each kernel 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} as the product of a shared excitation PSF and a detection PSF derived from the shared emission PSF, shifted according to the position of detector element i i . We incorporate this physical relationship into the optimisation, reconstructing all kernels { 𝐡 i } i = 1 N c ​ h \{\mathbf{h}_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N_{ch}} from the two shared excitation and emission PSFs. This reduces the number of unknowns and restricts the set of admissible solutions. We further introduce a pre-initialisation strategy for the kernel-generating networks, which stabilises the blind optimisation and makes it robust to translation ambiguities. Experiments on real ISM data show promising qualitative results.

blocks.en: 3.1 On the choice of the initialisation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 关于初始化的选择

blocks.en: As mentioned in Section 1 , blind problems are faced with sets of ambiguous solutions. Notably, SelfDeblur, and vanilla ( DIP-ISM ) are very sensitive to finding translated solutions, which depend on the initialization. To mitigate this, before starting the optimization of ( DIP-ISM ), we train for a few steps 𝐠 𝐡 \mathbf{g}_{\mathbf{h}} to output a centered isotropic Gaussian kernel of chosen variance σ \sigma . The goal is simply to give the optimization process a physically plausible starting point and, we hope, stay close to. This simple procedure proves to be very effective to guarantee centered solutions in practice, for various noise levels, initialisations and choices of σ \sigma .
blocks.zh: 如第1节所提到,盲目问题面临一系列模棱两可的解决办法。 值得注意的是,SelfDeblur和香草(DIP-ISM)对于找到翻译解决方案非常敏感,这取决于初始化. 为了缓解这种情况,在开始优化(DIP-ISM)前,我们先训练几步 g h\ mathbf{ g}_{\mathbf{h}输出一个所选差异的中线高斯内核 \\ sigma 。 目标只是给优化过程一个实际可行的起点,我们希望保持接近。 事实证明,这种简单的程序非常有效,可以在实践中保证以各种噪音水平、初始化和\sigma选择为中心的解决办法。

blocks.en: Contrary to other existing stabilization methods in the litterature [ 2 , 12 ] , this method does not necessitate any training set and works directly at the output level of the network making it very simple to use. Furthermore, pretraining the weights to meet an output also changes the Jacobian of 𝐠 𝐡 \mathbf{g}_{\mathbf{h}} to make a few of its singular values much more important than others, which does help at the beginning of the optimization to keep the solution close to its pretrained state.
blocks.zh: 与垃圾[2,12]中的其他现有稳定方法相反,这种方法不需要任何培训,而是直接在网络输出一级发挥作用,因此非常容易使用。 此外,为了达到一个输出,预先训练权重也会改变g h\ mathbf{g}_{\mathbf{h}的Jacobian,使其几个单数比其他的要重要得多,这确实有助于在优化之初使解决方案接近其被预先训练的状态.

blocks.en: 4 Numerical Results
blocks.zh: 4 数值结果

blocks.en:
We evaluated the proposed method from data obtained from a custom ISM system equipped with a 5 × 5 5\times 5 SPAD detector array [ 8 ] .
We chose for ( DIP-ISM ) to reconstruct the specimen 𝐱 \mathbf{x} using 𝐠 𝐱 \mathbf{g}_{\mathbf{x}} as a convolutional skip network, following the architecture used in SelfDeblur [ 9 ] , while 𝐠 𝐡 \mathbf{g}_{\mathbf{h}} was taken as a two-layer fully connected network with ReLU6 activation, followed by Softplus and L 1 L_{1} normalization. We optimize jointly the three networks by doing 10 3 10^{3} Adam steps, with image and kernel learning rates of 10 − 2 10^{-2} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} respectively, to minimize ℒ \mathcal{L} .
For comparison, we used MID [ 13 ] , which reconstructs the image through a multi-image Richardson–Lucy scheme using the 25 detector-dependent PSFs 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} constructed from excitation and emission PSFs calculated using vectorial diffraction theory. We also evaluated a non-blind DIP approach using the same fixed theoretical PSFs, providing a baseline for assessing the benefit of joint image and PSF estimation.

作为比较,我们使用了MID [13],它通过多图像的Richardson–Lucy方案重建了图像,它利用了25个由探测器依赖的PSF h i\mathb{h}_{i}从引用和释放PSF中构建,使用矢量分流理论计算出. 我们还利用同样的固定理论性指标评估了一种非盲目的DIP方法,为评估联合图像和PSF估计的益处提供了基线。

blocks.en: 4.1 Qualitative comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 定性比较

blocks.en: Figure 1 compares the conventional confocal image (obtained by summing all the scanned images), the theoretical and estimated effective PSFs, and the three image reconstructions. All three reconstruction methods resolve the main network of tubulin filaments. Compared with MID and DIP with fixed theoretical PSFs, blind DIP produces visually more pronounced fine filament structures, which may reflect its ability to account for optical aberrations affecting the acquisition.
blocks.zh: 图1比较了常规集合图像(取自所有被扫描的图像),理论和估计有效的PSF,以及三个图像重建. 所有三种重建方法都解决了输卵管丝网的主要问题。 相较于有固定理论PSF的MID和DIP,盲目的DIP会产生更显眼的细丝状结构,这可能反映出其能够对影响获取的光学偏差进行衡算.

blocks.en: The recovered effective PSFs differ from the theoretical ones in their apparent extent and spatial distribution ( fig. 1 ). A main advantage of our ( DIP-ISM ) method is that we recover the underlying excitation and emission PSFs which allow a much finer analysis of the optical system. For example, in fig. 2 the estimated excitation PSF has a diagonally elongated central lobe, consistent with astigmatism, a typical optical aberration that could then be corrected. In these estimated PSFs, the peripheral intensity on the border is not optically plausible and probably reflects an artifact of the blind estimation. However, these peripheral artefacts are largely suppressed in 𝐡 i \mathbf{h}_{i} by the pointwise multiplication of the spatially localised excitation and detection PSFs.
blocks.zh: 已恢复的有效PSF在明显程度和空间分布(图. 我们的(DIP-ISM)方法的主要优点是,我们回收了基本的激发和释放PSF,从而能够对光学系统进行更精细的分析。 例如,在无花果中. 2,估计的被激素PSF有相向延长的中叶,符合星相论,是一种典型的光学偏差,然后可以纠正. 在这些估计的PSF中,边界的外围强度在光学上不合理,可能反映了盲目的估计。 然而,在h i \ mathbf{h}_{i}中,这些外缘手工艺品基本上被通过空间定位激发和探测PSF的分点乘法压制.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Latent excitation (left) and emission (right) PSFs estimated jointly with the specimen by the proposed blind DIP approach on experimental tubulin data. Both exhibit a localized central peak, with additional diffuse and peripheral intensity.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a blind DIP approach for jointly estimating the specimen image and the excitation and emission PSFs for ISM imaging. By constructing each detector-dependent effective PSF from the shared excitation and emission PSFs and the detector geometry, the method incorporates the physical relationships among the kernels. On experimental tubulin data, the resulting reconstruction reveals fine filament details and estimates PSFs that differ from the theoretical model. These qualitative results support further investigation of blind DIP for ISM, including the stability and physical interpretation of the recovered PSFs and quantitative validation on suitable reference measurements.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一种盲目的DIP方法,用于联合估算样本图像以及用于ISM成像的激发和排放PSF. 通过从共享的激发和释放PSF以及探测器几何构造出每个由探测器依赖的有效PSF,这种方法包含了内核之间的物理关系. 在实验性管管素数据上,由此产生的重建揭示出细细的丝状细节并估计出与理论模型不同的PSF. 这些定性结果支持进一步调查对ISM的盲目DIP,包括恢复的PSF的稳定性和物理判读,以及对适当的参考测量进行定量验证.
